notes: Variant unit WLC.JOS.22.7.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base in the projection; it covers s021–s022 and changes no unit (rule 9).

The single 'the' of 'the one half tribe of Manasseh' goes to the article segmented on Manasseh under rule 29's fronting case, while 'one' and 'the other' are rule 15's supplied contrastive determiners on חֲצִי.

s027/s028: 'Moreover' writes גַּם's own lexeme, so the adverb takes it and the waw is unrepresented under rule 14's closing paragraph; the note records that the corpus does also align a waw to that word.
